senses.definition: (Baer, -שֵׁז van d. H. Gi), Inf. abs. Piʿlēl (Ges§ 56) from פָּרַשׂ (si vera l.), פ׳ עָלָיו עֲנָנוֹ Jb 26:9 a spreading his cloud upon it (but Bu Du al. read פֹּרֵשׂ, פָּרַשׂ, or פָרשֹׁ).
